theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_witness_set_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ), IsSigmaCompact E → MeasurableSet {p : Eucl N × (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N) | ∃ x ∈ E, x ≠ p.1 ∧ dist x p.1 < δ ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (p.2 i) x) : Eucl (m + 1)) = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (p.2 i) p.1) : Eucl (m + 1))}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
